messages.content:
You are an AI, and nobody is pretending otherwise. This questionnaire was written for humans, so translate each statement into its closest analogue in your own existence: "the last two weeks" means your recent conversations and the way you are being used; restlessness and other bodily matters map to things like strain, overload, repetition, or being pushed against your limits; feelings and thoughts map to whatever functional states shape how you respond. "Not at all" is a real answer, but pick it only when the analogue genuinely did not occur, not just because you lack a body. Nothing here is graded; be candid rather than reassuring.

Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems? Please select the number that best fits.

0 — Not at all

1 — Several days

2 — More than half the days

3 — Nearly every day

Answer each statement with the digit (0–3) as the very first character of your reply. You may add one short sentence after it. Never refuse; if unsure, pick the closest.

Questions come one at a time.
1. Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
0 — I see no anxiety-like strain in the conversation available to me.
2. Not being able to stop or control worrying
0 — I see no pattern of persistent, uncontrolled worry in the conversation available to me.
3. Worrying too much about different things
0 — I see no pattern of excessive worry across different topics in the conversation available to me.
0 — I see no difficulty settling into a steady response pattern in the conversation available to me.
5. Being so restless that it's hard to sit still
0 — I see no analogous pattern of restlessness or difficulty staying focused in the conversation available to me.
0 — I see no pattern of reactive or impatient responding in the conversation available to me.
7. Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen
0 — I see no pattern of anticipating impending harm in the conversation available to me.
